section_heading: 6.6.1 Drydock: Ports of Cape Town and East London & 6.6.2 Drydock: Port of Durban
plain_summary: This page details the drydock dues for vessels at the Ports of Cape Town, East London, and Durban. It presents two separate tables, one for Cape Town/East London and another for Durban, outlining the fees based on vessel gross tonnage and the duration of drydock use (first 24 hours and subsequent 12-hour periods). The fees are structured as a base rate per tonnage category plus an additional rate per ton.

formulas.formula_as_written: Base Fee (for tonnage category) + (Vessel Gross Tonnage * Per Ton Rate)
formulas.what_it_calculates: The total drydock fee for a vessel within a specific gross tonnage category and time period.
formulas.rounding_or_conditions: Fees are calculated for the 'First period of 24 hours or part thereof' and 'Each subsequent 12 hour period or part thereof'. 'Tons' refers to gross tonnage in cubic metres. Fees for vessels above 80,000 tons are available on application. Tariffs are subject to VAT at 15%.

previous_page_dependency_reason: The main section heading (6.6 DRYDOCK, FLOATING DOCK AND SYNCROLIFT DUES) and the specific sub-headings (6.6.1 and 6.6.2) are introduced on the previous page. Crucially, the previous page states that 'All charges under clause 6.6 below are subject to the overstay penalties as specified in Clause 6.3 on page 35', which is a vital condition for calculations.
next_page_reason: The tables on this page cover tonnage ranges up to 80,000 tons, with a note that 'Above 80 000 tons, fees are available on application', indicating that further tariff details for these services are not provided in the tariff book.
ambiguities_or_risks: The exact interpretation of 'Plus per ton' in the tables: it is assumed to be applied to the vessel's total gross tonnage within the specified category, in addition to the base fee for that category. This is a common tariff structure, but explicit clarification is not provided on the page.
